verdict: Organic profiles are your only active source; paid lead generation is offline.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, 395 total Google Business Profile actions were recorded — 14 calls, 293 direction requests, and 88 website clicks — with no paid media running on any channel. GBP engagement declined sharply at Forte Precision Metals (down 42%) and Advance Grinding Services (down 43%) over the last 7 days, while O'Hare Precision Metals bucked the trend with a 25% week-over-week increase, though its search clicks dropped 39% in the same window. Two of O'Hare's three profiles generated zero calls across the full 28 days, pointing to a profile content gap we are actively working to close. CRM buildout, site reindexing, and outreach sequences are all in motion with completion targeted by end of October, which should open additional lead channels before the next reporting period.
